svg.title: EduFlow System Architecture
svg.desc: Six-step flow from student login through LMS/Outlook sync, AI extraction, LLM scheduling, to dashboard and notifications

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does EduFlow handle student authentication?')
sendPrompt('How does EduFlow connect to the LMS?')
sendPrompt('How does EduFlow connect to Outlook?')
sendPrompt('Why did EduFlow choose Supabase as the database?')
sendPrompt('How does EduFlow extract tasks and deadlines with AI?')
sendPrompt('How does EduFlows scheduling algorithm work?')
g.text: Fits study blocks around free time

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the EduFlow dashboard show?')
sendPrompt('How does EduFlow calendar view work?')
sendPrompt('How do EduFlow smart notifications work?')
